import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Fetch all HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION sensitive areas
query_healthcare = text("""
SELECT id, name, ST_Centroid(geometry) as centroid
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
""")
df_healthcare = pd.read_sql(query_healthcare, engine)
print(f"Total HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION sensitive areas: {len(df_healthcare)}")
print(df_healthcare.head())

# Step 2: Fetch all GENERAL-type air quality stations
query_general = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, coordinate
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE station_type = 'GENERAL'
""")
df_general = pd.read_sql(query_general, engine)
print(f"\nTotal GENERAL-type stations: {len(df_general)}")
print(df_general)

# Step 3: Compute count of distinct healthcare institutions within 3000m of at least one general station
query_count = text("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) as health_general_3km
FROM sensitive_area sa
WHERE sa.category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM air_quality_station aqs
    WHERE aqs.station_type = 'GENERAL'
    AND ST_Distance(
        ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography,
        aqs.coordinate::geography
    ) <= 3000
)
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query_count, engine)
health_general_3km = int(result['health_general_3km'].values[0])
print(f"\nHealthcare institutions within 3000m of at least one GENERAL station: {health_general_3km}")

# Set output variable
health_general_3km = health_general_3km

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query to count distinct healthcare institutions within 3000m of at least one GENERAL station
query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) as count
FROM sensitive_area sa
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON ST_Distance(
    ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography,
    aqs.coordinate
) <= 3000
WHERE sa.category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
AND aqs.station_type = 'GENERAL'
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)

# Assign the result to the required variable
health_general_3km = int(result['count'].values[0])
print(f"health_general_3km: {health_general_3km}")
